text:
Priya R: Quick Q — we need to finalize inbound routing for the May webinar landing. Primary goal: capture SQLs from webinar signups and benchmark post. Does the redirect map for /webinars/may-q2 still point to /resources/webinars? We want a canonical landing per keyword cluster (benchmark vs launch vs demo) and clean internal linking. Anyone own the redirect sheet?
Liam: I have the sheet — updated rows for webinar. main keyword: "redwood inference benchmark" -> landing at /resources/webinars/redwood-inference-benchmark-2026. Currently old slug redirects to /blog/benchmark-2025 which we should change.
Priya R: Can we also add schema for event markup (Event + speaker) and JSON-LD? Google needs event schema for webinar rich result.
Eva: Yes. I'll add schema. Quick snippet I plan to add:
```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood Inference Benchmark Webinar","startDate":"2026-05-12T16:00:00Z","organizer":{"@type":"Organization","name":"Redwood Inference"}}
```
Sam G: Redirects: we should avoid 302s. Use 301 for permanent slug moves. Proposed nginx rule:
```
rewrite ^/blog/benchmark-2025$ /resources/webinars/redwood-inference-benchmark-2026 permanent;
```
Liam: Also add internal linking from product pages: /docs/performance -> link to webinar landing with anchor text "benchmark webinar". That will pass link equity.
Priya R: SEO Bot, run a redirect audit on the two domains and flag chains longer than 2 hops? @seo-bot
SEO Bot: scheduled: redirect-audit-1785554321 started. Will DM results in ~10m :mag:
Eva: I updated the sheet (link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/placeholder) — added canonical tag plan and schema column. I also added a note to set rel=prev/next for the blog series.
Sam G: FYI we need to update canonical on legacy pages to point to new landing not index. I'll do a quick PR for nginx conf.
Priya R: Action items: Eva — add JSON-LD and add speaker markup. Liam — update GTM event for webinar signups and confirm UTM flow. Sam — deploy redirect rule and update canonical headers. I'll QA once SEO Bot posts audit. Deadline EOD Wed.
Liam: Got it. I'll drop the UTM template here.
Liam: utm_source=blog&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=webinar_may2026
Eva: :thumbsup: I'll add to schema and push to staging.
SEO Bot: redirect-audit-1785554321 done. 2 chains found: /old-blog/bench -> /blog/benchmark-2025 -> /resources/webinars/redwood-inference-benchmark-2026. Recommend direct 301 from /old-blog/bench.
Priya R: Perfect. Thanks everyone. I'll add the final mapping to the launch checklist.
